name: Rose Hips
source:
Welcome to Rose Hips, a lovely little tea shop with a colorful array of customers — especially on Hearts Day, when it's common to eschew clothing.

Play as Papaya the flowercat, equip your fox girlfriend into your miscellaneous accessory slot, and strike up some conversations.  Who knows what might happen?

[From [url=https://eevee.itch.io/rose-hips]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎光临Rose Hips，这是一家可爱的小茶店，顾客五花八门，尤其是在红心节那天，人们通常不穿衣服。

扮演花猫木瓜，将你的狐狸女友装备到你的各种配件槽中，并进行一些对话。谁知道会发生什么？

[来自[url=https://eevee.itch.io/rose-hips]itch.io[/url]]
